title: 'I'm tired': India wushu player Divyanshi breaks down after Asian Games axing

Divyanshi’s father, Sunil, said the family was informed about the decision only on Friday morning. He claimed that they were not given any reason for her removal.

title: Harvard University has a 'September message' for all international students
content: Harvard University has alerted international students about significant F-1 and J-1 visa rule changes. New Department of Homeland Security rules replace the duration of status system with fixed visa end dates. Students re-entering the US after September 15 will face stricter limits and new visa frameworks. Those already in the US before this date will generally retain current protections and benefits.

title: At 4, Treesha Thosar broke Kamal Haasan’s record as youngest National Award winner
content: At just four years old, Treesha Thosar has made history by winning a National Film Award for her remarkable performance in Naal 2, becoming the youngest winner in Indian cinema. This remarkable achievement surpasses the record of acclaimed actor Kamal Haasan, who extended his congratulations through a heartfelt video call. Her victory became a standout moment during the 71st National Film Awards ceremony.

title: 1980s AI Photo trend: 5 ChatGPT prompts to create Kerala-style retro images
content: A social media trend uses ChatGPT to recreate photos in 1980s styles. Users are now focusing on regional aesthetics, specifically 1980s Kerala and Malayali culture. Prompts request authentic family, wedding, college, and studio portraits from the period. These images incorporate traditional clothing, jewellery, and home settings from Kerala. The AI maintains recognizable facial features while adding retro photographic elements.

title: 160-year-old St Louis church saved after fire, legal fight and condemnation
content: Once deemed condemned, a 160-year-old church in St. Louis has been granted a new lease on life following a legal battle. Thanks to the Soulard Restoration Group’s successful court order, rehabilitation efforts can now commence. The St. Louis Receivership Group will finance the repairs, while local advocates are determined to protect the historic site from being torn down.

title: Elon Musk's Cybercab rollout puts US safety rules to test as NHTSA audits 1,000 cars
content: Tesla's new Cybercab robotaxis are now operating in Texas without traditional controls. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration has opened an audit of these vehicles. US safety regulations were primarily designed for human-driven cars. Tesla's strategy relies on self-driving software and robotics for its valuation. Experts suggest Tesla may challenge regulatory interpretations to deploy its vehicles.

title: Lukas Dostal’s journey from Czech village to NHL star making an impact off ice
content: A path from a tiny Czech town to the Anaheim Ducks net has created a special connection between success in the NHL and backing from the community for Lukas Dostal. One side of the story is his work in creating charitable contributions through saves, through programs that help people in need. His personal outreach and connection to fans have added a new dimension to a journey that goes well beyond hockey.

title: 'Wanted to marry each other': How Delhi man, his girlfriend plotted wife's murder
content: A husband and his alleged girlfriend were arrested for murdering his wife in Delhi last month. Their illicit relationship emerged as the primary motive behind the brutal killing. Extensive CCTV footage analysis across multiple states led to their apprehension. The husband allegedly conspired with his girlfriend to commit the murder. Further investigation is ongoing to establish all details of the crime.

title: Rape convict Prajwal Revanna's smuggled jail phone contained explicit videos
content: Dozens of pornographic videos were discovered on devices seized from jailed former MP Prajwal Revanna.  He allegedly received a mobile phone and other items through a smuggling operation.  Five individuals, including a jail staffer, were arrested in connection with this incident.  Revanna reportedly paid a significant sum to have the contraband smuggled into the prison.  Investigators are continuing their probe into the coordinated smuggling of these items.

title: CAS closing price under review: Sebi proposes 2 options for expiry settlement
content: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) is actively exploring modifications to how derivative settlement prices are calculated. Two alternative methods are currently up for review, inviting stakeholder feedback. These revisions aim to alleviate concerns related to the price from the closing auction session. Stakeholders have until October 3rd to share their insights on adopting a blended VWAP or maintaining the status quo with the existing methodology.

title: 1980s AI photo trend: Bumrah, Sooryavanshi get hilarious makeovers
content: The portraits, featured in a video shared by the BCCI, showed the players in classic 1980s looks, complete with bell-bottom jeans, big sunglasses and retro hairstyles. Two days before the series, the Indian players gathered at their hotel for a photo session. But before it began, they found a table filled with AI-generated pictures of themselves.

title: China’s Air Force One: Inside Xi Jinping’s Boeing 747-8 Presidential Jet
content: China's presidential transport utilizes a specially converted Boeing 747-8I aircraft. This aircraft is branded with Air China and carries specific registration details. Several other nations also employ VIP-configured 747-8I models for their leaders. The United States recently adopted a version of this aircraft as a stopgap transport. India and Japan, among others, now use variants of the modern Boeing-777.

title: Woman whips out gun after father refuses to help with car loan
content: In Sahibabad, a woman is on the run after pointing a pistol at her father, who refused to verify her address for a car loan. Reports indicate she forcibly entered the property and threatened not only her father but also her sister-in-law when she tried to intervene. Authorities are actively searching for both the woman and her friend involved in the incident.

title: Bulletproof, blast-resistant, V12-powered: Meet Xi Jinping’s 'Red Banner' limousine
content: Chinese President Xi Jinping will attend the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi. He is expected to travel in the heavily protected Hongqi N701 state limousine. This bespoke vehicle offers significant security features for leadership protection. The N701's presence highlights China's approach to leadership security. Comparisons are drawn to the US President's armored vehicle, 'The Beast'.

title: Xi Jinping in Delhi: China talks 'fairness, justice' ahead of PM Modi meet
content: Ahead of the visit, China’s state-run Global Times has described Brics as an increasingly important platform at a time of global uncertainty. In an editorial, the newspaper said the grouping’s strength came from its commitment to openness, cooperation and fairness. The editorial also highlighted China’s support for the New Development Bank, the expansion of Brics and cooperation in different areas.

title: 'Mirzapur The Movie' BO Day 9 [LIVE]: Pankaj Tripathi film crosses Rs 162 crore India net
content: 'Mirzapur The Movie' has comfortably crossed the Rs. 150 crore mark in India as it enters Day 9, with its net collection now standing at Rs. 159.63 crore. The Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal and Ravi Kishan starrer has settled into a slower but steady second-week pace, even as the film's overall worldwide tally pushes well past Rs. 225 crore. With the Rs. 150 crore milestone now behind it, attention has shifted to how much further the crime drama can stretch its theatrical run in the coming days.

title: Wangchuk appeals for support to Ladakh’s fight for democracy; CJP responds
content: Leaders from Ladakh are pressing for commitments concerning land and governance choices. They recently engaged with the Home Ministry to discuss ways to protect local heritage. While a follow-up meeting was arranged, no concrete measures were promised, leading to concerns about potential significant administrative shifts. A protest is on the horizon if assurances aren't given promptly.

title: 'Allow easy movement to professionals': Piyush Goyal urges Brics states
content: Piyush Goyal urged Brics nations to dismantle trade barriers and open markets. He also called for linking payment systems and trading in local currencies. Streamlining customs and promoting services trade were also highlighted by the minister. External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar emphasized transparent trade and investment practices. The goal is to foster business partnerships and market access for member nations.

title: Applied, invested, still outside: Pakistan is still waiting at the Brics door
content: Pakistan publicly confirmed its Brics membership application in 2023, when the grouping was preparing for a major expansion under Russia’s presidency. Foreign Office spokesperson Mumtaz Zahra Baloch announced the move during her weekly press briefing."Yes, I can confirm that Pakistan has made a formal request to join Brics, which we believe is an important grouping of developing countries," Baloch said.

title: China Southern to resume Guangzhou-Delhi flights ahead of Xi's India visit
content: The announcement came ahead of Chinese President Xi Jinping’s visit to India for the Brics summit. The airline said the resumption would take its total operations across eight round-trip routes in South Asia to more than 100 flights a week. The Guangzhou-New Delhi service had been suspended for six years.

title: Russia & Iran hit out at US 'aggression', pose a challenge for Brics host India
content: Russia and Iran criticized Western sanctions and aggression at the BRICS Business Forum.  Both nations called for strategies to enhance the group's resilience against external pressures.  Iranian President Pezeshkian highlighted economic security's link to national and regional stability.  Russian President Putin condemned Western dominance tactics and infrastructure destruction.  Leaders discussed expanding trade in local currencies and leveraging the New Development Bank.

title: Uditi Singh opens up about breakup with Karan Wahi; says 'It was hard'

Their journey began in London and lasted two and a half years, resulting in a tough breakup. Currently, Uditi is participating in Bigg Boss 20, while Karan is showcasing his skills in Khatron Ke Khiladi 15.

title: Why JNU’s protest culture is facing quiet moment
content: At Jawaharlal Nehru University, the response to recent sexual harassment allegations has been surprisingly low-key. Unlike earlier protests that disrupted classes for days, this time students reported inappropriate behavior and solicitations back in May. The emergence of public scrutiny took several months, shrouded in anonymity for the accused. This tempered response stands in stark contrast to earlier, passionate mobilizations on campus.

title: 3-minute intense exercise may beat 90-minute cycling, study finds
content: Emerging research highlights the profound impact of brief high-intensity workouts on blood chemistry, with nearly 25% of blood proteins undergoing transformation after just three minutes of sprinting. Comparatively, a prolonged session of moderate cycling for ninety minutes triggers only slight changes. This evidence suggests that while both short and long exercise sessions contribute uniquely to fitness and health, the effects of intense exercises promote rapid bodily upgrades.

title: Pickaxe Mountain next? New activity at US bunker-buster test site fuels speculation
content: Construction at a New Mexico weapons test site is drawing attention.  This activity may be tied to planning a future strike on Iran's nuclear facility.  The Defense Threat Reduction Agency awarded a contract for work at the ALT-SHIST site.  This agency previously developed bunker-buster bombs used in strikes on Iran.  The specific link to Pickaxe Mountain remains unconfirmed by officials.

title: Hyd armoury heist: Fired ex-Armyman may have stolen weapons for ‘revenge’

After being confronted by his wife, the ex-serviceman returned willingly, leading authorities to the recovery of the weapons concealed beneath hay stacks in Nagarkurnool district.

title: Ice cream to defence: How Canada’s tariff war with US is boosting local businesses
